reviews.comment: He's an amazing professor. Homework is light compared to other professors and actually pretty helpful. If you're up with 206 work then final is not bad either. I got somewhere in the 60's from a day's worth of studying (but I had studied everything for my 206 final before). He actively tries to make the class better for all students.

He makes his class very easy. All of his assignments were very doable in a day's worth of time. The final is ridiculously hard. I had 100 in his class up until the final which dropped me to a B. If you want someone to prepare you for that, take someone else. If you want a light workload, take him.
The lectures were very slow, and boring, we had a guest speaker who straight up contradicted herself about ethics in engineering, and the final exam... good luck
Not much to say, he is nice caring and homeworks are easy and fast. 216 just kinda sucks as a class.

216 is bad but its not his fault :( the lecture doesnt match the assignments but they're easy and i emailed him a couple of times w late submissions and he gave full credit. he let you go to a diff lecture/final exam time if you emailed him. i had like a 94 average and got a 52 on exam which was curved to a 77 and i got an 91 in the class

Class was alright. I stopped going to lecture after the second week and only showed up for the group project after. You'll probably do better if you pay attention, but I got in the 40s on the final and passed with an A. The average was a 35.

Very nice guy, 216 is just a poorly organized class, especially for people already in a major. Try your best to get 100s on all his assignments and the labs, because the final will tank your grade if you don't have time to study for it. Thankfully he curves pretty heavily at the end. I barely knew anything on the final and I got an A.

216 is going to have a super hard final regardless of who you take. Brooks just makes the rest of the course super easy. All of his assignments are free 100s, super lenient with late submissions, accepts them for full credit. Labs are the same for all, not too hard. Got a 45 on the final with minimal prep and still ended up with an A. 10/10 prof

It's very apparent that Professor Brooks cares about his students and wants his students to succeed. The ENGR 216 structure isn't the best often scattered which can make it hard to find importance in the class. As long as you do good on your homeworks, labs, and take opportunities to raise your grade, then you'll be chilling in this class.

The class really wasn't that bad it was just annoying because the class seemed more stats based than physics. For instance a big portion of the class at the beginning during the lecture is uncertainty related things. The labs were really fun though. The TA's I had were amazing.

Likely, it won't matter who you take for 216 as long as you do well in the labs, but Professor Brooks makes his rare homework incredibly easy and takes no longer than 30 minutes. As a professor, he is very kind and accessible. Additionally, he prioritized your professional development, which ultimately helped me get a research position.

No matter which professor you have for 216, it will be very terrifying. The course itself is very poorly structured, but Professor Brooks is very cognizant of this, and was very helpful. My only complaint about him is that he assigns very little homework during the term, and so the final exam is very difficult. Prepare yourself to succeed.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Randy brooks is a good professor, it's not about him it's about the course itself. I had to retake this class because in tamu you cannot transfer labs.  for me it was a year since I passed this class in a community college so I did not remember anything. it would be much easier if it was not such a gap in between.
CLEN 181: Class is eh, but we got free ice cream, I fully support this type of learning.

Professor Brooks is awesome! very nice man and truly cares about his students. Lots of little homework assignments, midterm worth 5% and he lets you get credit back, final is very heavily weighted so study a lot for it.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He's a good professor and not hard at all. I shouldn't have gotten a C, I got a 0 in one of the labs for being stupid and i bombed the final. As long as you get all your labs done and maintain a 90> average on them youll be good. Final always gets curved and the midterm you can retake at home if you miss any questions. do all assingments.

Brooks is the best engineering professor I've had so far. Smart guy with a cool background who cares about his students. He will go out of his way to help you when the university and admin fails. Interesting lectures and easy assignments. The final was horrible but that's the case with all 216/217 classes. He curved the semester grade by 7.5%.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: All assignments are free 100s until final. I honestly preferred this model since you just have to lock in for the final. Ended up getting enough for an A even without the final grade curve (but dw there was a curve). Cool guy and obviously cares a lot about his students. Labs are tedious but grades are up to which TAs you get.
best engineering 217 teacher, easy a. final is hard but had a 30 point curve i think. homeworks were easy and took less than 30 minutes per week. kind teacher.

Brooks is a good guy, not so good professor. You can tell that he's passionate about what he's teaching, but what he does teach is all over the place. The assignments aren't hard, but you don't really learn anything from them. Then there's the midterm and final which he doesn't really prepare you for. The labs and reports are easy, just tedious.

Lowkey buns. Lectures don't help you at all for the midterm or final. This class is just padding your grade for the final which he does not prepare you for at all. He himself is a nice guy but for someone who is influential in the curriculum for this class he doesn't do anything at all. Will use lecture time to vent about his career that died out.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment:
While this professor is great when it comes to teaching topics that he enjoys, he SEVERELY underprepares you for the classes final, which accounts for 25% of the course grade.
The practice final doesn't provide explanations for incorrect answers. While this isn't too bad, he also doesn't cover some of the topics (ever) for the final in class.

Dr. Brooks is so nice and always makes sure to check up on students. His lectures are easy to follow and gives lots of resources to help everyone. Even gave opportunities to give feedback on our etam essays so that they were the best they could be. Gives you lots of attempts on homework and lots of study material for midterm and final.

I think he's the GOAT of 216. He makes lectures interesting to follow and is a very understanding guy. He gives resources online to help a lot, and he's very involved in your success. I wish I could take him to every lab class tbh.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Mr. Brooks is an amazing teacher and this class was super easy and did not take up much time outside of class. That being said, it leaves you very unprepared for both the mid-term and the final. If you take Mr. Brooks, I would highly recommend studying for the final early and with people who understand the topics.

Randy Brooks is an amazing individual. However he isn't the best at teaching. He severely underprepares u for the final and the midterm. Teaches random things that have nothing to do with the midterm and exam. So make sure u get those materials from another class. However he is super chill and if u turn in something late just email him.
GOAT

A good guy, but a terrible professor. Learned absolutely nothing from his class to prepare me for the final. While he gave very easy participation level assignments other classes actually got work to prepare them for the finals. Keep in mind this is one of the hardest finals you take and has a average of under 50%. If you get him drop him.

I took Dr. Brooks over the fall, the class was filled with easy participation grades. Due to how easy the class lectures were I was very underprepared for the final while other professors had more difficult lecture assignments and better-equipped students for the final exam. Dr. Brooks was a great professor and gave a massive curve on the final.

Great professor as he made the class very easy. However, since it was so easy, I was not prepared for the exam. I did not have a good grasp on PHYS 207, which made it much harder to get a good grade on the exam. But, you can guarantee a B if you just show up and do the few assignments he provides. The lab portion difficulty depends on your TA.

Lectures were very easygoing; each week's homework assignments never took more than half an hour. The labs went smoothly with our TAs and the reports were graded fairly. The only critique is that the final exam is tough and you must remember the small details from the lectures to do great. Brooks added energy and quality to somewhat boring lectures

Brooks is a good prof that cares about his students, but the class format really doesn't work. You can basically forget this class exists for the whole year, and then the final is absurd. The average was a 52 and was not curved. This class is an easy A all the way up until the final. Brooks does the best that he can do with this system.

Very poor class format, no quizzes or practice tests, then throws you into final exam. Final was fill in the blank. Fill in the blank on an ENGINEERING exam, I thought that was interesting. Easy class no homework. I was a 4.0 cumulative GPA before this class. Had a 99 in the class before the Final (39% avg), finished with an 89. good guy, bad class

Dr. Brooks is a great person, and it's a shame he teaches a course that's run so poorly by the department. He wants his students to succeed and is very passionate about the topics he teaches, specifically ethics. Everything is super easy until the final, which is impossibly difficult and had an average in the 30s.

The semester is super easy, so it all comes down to the final, where our class average was about a 40 making it almost impossible to get an A unless you ace the final which is very hard considering there are no materials to prepare for it. If you don't mind getting a B he is great, otherwise I don't recommend.

It is true that Brooks doesn't assign HW and therefore most of the semester is easy, but I still wouldn't take him again. His final was absurdly difficult. It was essentially a fill-in-the-blank vocab exam worth 20% of your grade. He doesn't prepare you at all and questions come from everywhere on the slides. I would not recommend this prof at all.
Great professor, useless class. He doesn't assign much work so the final is hard to prepare for but the lab grades make up for the bad final grade.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Brooks is a great guy and very easygoing, but 217 is just a horrible class. It's easy all year so you're super unprepared for the final at the end of the semester. Brooks barely assigned homework and I could keep a 100 for the lecture portion all year, so I highly recommend him.
great prof would recommend. was really nice all around good guy
He gives good feedback. Easy to talk to and is available outside of class. Lectures are decent and interactive.

ENGR 102 - Group coding projects, zybook helps. Final is hard so do well in everything else. Participate and do assignments and you should easily get an A.
ENGR 216 - 6 Group projects, the team might be bad but if you do the work it's hard to get below 80. He's easy grader so if did everything get high 90s. Easy final (project) put work into it.

Great professor. There are a lot of team assignments. If you strive to be team leader in each one of your groups throughout the semester, you should make an A. Do not be afraid to ask for help, I recommend attending office hours for any help on the team assignments. He may not give you the answer, but he will give you the tools needed to find it.

Professor Brooks classes are very easy to pick up on if your whole team works together. However, the tests are extremely hard and 1 question on the test can drop your average grade from a 96 to an 84 if you dont really take on account of the time and understanding of the course.
Real nice guy just worry about the final. He's an easy grader.
Real nice guy just put in the work and be respectful.

Brooks is a real sweetheart. It's clear that he wants all of his students to succeed; understanding the content of the course comes before just getting the grade. Make an honest attempt to do well and he'll take care of you :)
